title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 resources and improve audit logging for KMS operations. Migration included to add residency metadata to existing keys. No customer-visible API changes; admin policy enforcement may require updates to custom roles.
description: Motivation: enforce KMS region pinning at the RBAC v2 layer and harden audit logging for KMS-residency decisions. Customers using cross-region keys and older role bundles could accidentally bypass residency constraints; this PR makes enforcement explicit and adds more detailed audit entries for policy evaluation and KMS binding decisions. Changes: 1) new enforcement hook in rbac v2 enforcer that rejects or flags requests where the requested KMS key region does not match the resource residency policy; 2) structured audit events for KMS decisions (kmspolicy.check, kmspolicy.enforce, kmspolicy.migration) emitted to our audit-log pipeline with key metadata (key_id, requested_region, allowed_regions, decision, rule_id); 3) migration to annotate existing KMS keys referenced in policies with residency metadata where resolvable and to surface unresolved keys in the admin console; 4) small docs and SDK surface notes and tests. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is audit-and-continue for customers on legacy flag (rbac_v2.kms_residency_mode=auditor) to avoid immediate breakage; customers on strict mode will see enforcement failures and must update policies. Testing: unit tests for policy evaluation matrix, integration tests that spin up a local KMS emulator to validate audit events and enforcement semantics, e2e test in the canary namespace to validate real traffic behavior. Rollout plan: feature gated behind an infra flag + gradual rollout to Dedicated customers, 72-hour monitoring window with rollback playbook. Checklist: - [x] Core enforcement logic implemented - [x] Migration script added - [x] Structured audit events wired to audit pipeline - [x] SDK docs update - [x] Unit/integration/e2e tests - [x] Performance benchmark for enforcer (<= 2% p99 overhead) Notes: See linked Linear ENG-4321 for design doc and SEC-118 for threat model. This description includes implementation-level notes and the public-facing rationale for reviewers and release engineers.

testing_summary: Added 23 unit tests, 6 integration tests against kms-emulator, and an e2e canary that passed in staging. Load benchmark shows <2% p99 overhead.
